{"source":"docs/50-59-research-program/59-provider-rpc/59.44-cloud-rpc-arrow-boundaries.d2","sourceDigest":"00a68e4a7bbbc46b86905176bd65f1c2e7e28dc2c84f5e8207e2fa510ee54325","layout":"model-map","nodes":[{"id":"title","type":"text","label":"CLOUD / RPC / DATA · ONE EXECUTION AUTHORITY"},{"id":"go","type":"rectangle","label":"Go cloud / protocol ingress
Discovery and route candidates
Canonical task / frozen context
No provider execution credentials"},{"id":"request","type":"rectangle","label":"Rust request admission
Current Policy / floor / owner
Original claim and budget hold
Durable one-use invocation"},{"id":"provider","type":"rectangle","label":"Provider / tool endpoint
Exact destination and body
Partial IO remains uncertain"},{"id":"guard","type":"rectangle","label":"Rust response release
Recheck after capacity wait
Every row / original range / context
Fixed encoding and immutable data"},{"id":"queue","type":"rectangle","label":"Bounded private output
Reserve outside deciding lock
Insert inside final row guard
Admitted buffers may drain"},{"id":"observe","type":"rectangle","label":"Go bounds decode / owns data
Scheme Session proposes next step
Original identity survives reconnect
Fresh admission for every effect"},{"id":"unknown","type":"rectangle","label":"Unknown / incomplete outcome
Original claim and hold retained
Pending range cannot be replayed
Inspect the exact original outcome"},{"id":"footer","type":"text","label":"Capacity credit is not authority · Reconnect is not a fresh claim
Queue delivery is not settlement · No automatic execution retry"}],"edges":[{"id":"(go -> request)[0]","source":"go","target":"request","label":"gRPC / Protobuf","sourceArrow":false,"targetArrow":true,"sourceMarker":"none","targetMarker":"triangle"},{"id":"(request -> provider)[0]","source":"request","target":"provider","label":"Guarded request","sourceArrow":false,"targetArrow":true,"sourceMarker":"none","targetMarker":"triangle"},{"id":"(provider -> guard)[0]","source":"provider","target":"guard","label":"Owned typed rows","sourceArrow":false,"targetArrow":true,"sourceMarker":"none","targetMarker":"triangle"},{"id":"(guard -> queue)[0]","source":"guard","target":"queue","label":"Current per-row admission","sourceArrow":false,"targetArrow":true,"sourceMarker":"none","targetMarker":"triangle"},{"id":"(queue -> observe)[0]","source":"queue","target":"observe","label":"Protobuf / Arrow IPC","sourceArrow":false,"targetArrow":true,"sourceMarker":"none","targetMarker":"triangle"},{"id":"(observe -> go)[0]","source":"observe","target":"go","label":"Continuation proposal","sourceArrow":false,"targetArrow":true,"sourceMarker":"none","targetMarker":"triangle"},{"id":"(guard -> unknown)[0]","source":"guard","target":"unknown","label":"Reject / cancel / lost commit","sourceArrow":false,"targetArrow":true,"sourceMarker":"none","targetMarker":"triangle"},{"id":"(observe -> unknown)[0]","source":"observe","target":"unknown","label":"Missing terminal evidence","sourceArrow":false,"targetArrow":true,"sourceMarker":"none","targetMarker":"triangle"}]}
